verdict.rationale: Devin is itself a coding agent, but its docs describe a first-party Devin MCP server that gives "any MCP-compatible AI agent or IDE" access to session management, playbooks, knowledge and scheduling, so the server axis applies and is met. The CLI's MCP client support (docs-12/13/14/21, probe-3) is client-side and is not credited here. missing for 10: documented connection/authentication setup for the server endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
